priorityList: Maintain your Agony, and Corruption effects at all times.
Cast Unstable Affliction if you are at maximum Soul Shards.
Cast Haunt whenever available.
Make sure to have 2 or less Soul Shards before casting Dark Harvest.
Cast Dark Harvest whenever available with any periodic effect such as Corruption, Agony or Unstable Affliction active on target.
Cast Unstable Affliction to avoid capping shards.
Cast Drain Soul as a filler.
Cast Shadow Bolt as a filler.
